the-mans and-have-feared afraid great YHWH ; and-have-sacrificed sacrifice to/for-YHWH, vows and-have-vowed.
YHWH fish great and-has-counted, to/for-swallow Jonah ; Jonah and-has-been in-bellies-of the-fish, three days and-three nights.
Jonah and-has-self-prayed, toward YHWH god-of-him ; from-bellies-of the-fish.
and-has-said I-have-called from-distress to/for-me toward YHWH and-has-answered-me ; from-belly-of hell I-have-cried you-have-heard voice-of-me.
and-you-have-made-throw-me depth in-heart-of seas, and-river he-will-turn-me ; all-of waves-of-you and-heaps-of-you on-me have-passed.
and-I have-said, have-been-driven before eyes-of-you ; surely I-will-make-add to/for-make-look, toward temple-of holiness-of-you.
waters have-surrounded-me until soul, abyss will-turn-me ; red saddled to/for-head-of-me.
to/for-shapes-of mountains I-have-gone, the-land bars-of-her about-me to/for-age ; and-you-have-made-ascend from-pit lifes-of-me YHWH god-of-me.
in-self-enfeeble on-me soul-of-me, YHWH I-have-remembered ; prayer-of-me, and-has-come toward-you toward temple-of holiness-of-you.
keeping vanities-of vanity ; kindness-of-them they-will-leave.

YHWH and-has-said to/for-the-fish ; and-he-has-made-vomit Jonah toward the-dryland.
word-of YHWH and-has-been toward Jonah second to/for-say.
rise walk toward Nineveh the-city the-great ; and-call toward-her the-proclamation, who I speaking toward-you.
Jonah and-has-risen and-has-walked toward Nineveh like-word-of YHWH ; city great has-been and-Nineveh to/for-god, journey-of three-of days.
Jonah and-has-made-begin to/for-come in-the-city, journey-of day one ; and-has-called and-has-said, still forty day, and-Nineveh overturned.
mans-of Nineveh and-have-made-faithful in-god ; and-have-called fast sacks from-great-of-them and-have-clothed, and-until small-of-them.
the-word and-has-touched toward king-of Nineveh, and-has-risen from-throne-of-him, and-has-made-pass clothing-of-him on-him ; sack and-has-covered, and-has-dwelt on the-ash.

and-he-has-made-out and-he-has-said in-Nineveh, from-taste-of the-king and-great-of-him to/for-say ; the-man and-the-animal the-cattle and-the-flock do-not let-them-perceive anything, do-not let-them-pasture, and-water do-not let-them-drink.
sacks and-will-cover the-man and-the-animal, and-will-call toward god in-force ; and-they-will-return man from-way-of-him the-evil, and-from the-violence who in-palms-of-them.
who knowing will-return, the-god and-has-been-sorried ; and-he-has-returned from-burning-of nose-of-him and-not we-will-perish.
the-god and-has-seen deeds-of-them, for they-have-returned from-way-of-them the-evil ; the-god and-has-been-sorried on the-evil who has-spoken to/for-do to/for-them and-not has-done.
Jonah and-has-eviled toward evil great ; and-he-has-kindled to/for-him.

YHWH and-has-self-prayed toward and-has-said oh YHWH is-it-not this word-of-me until be-of-me on ground-of-me, on thus I-have-meeted to/for-flee Tarshish-ward ; for I-have-known for you El gracious and-compassionate, slow-of noses and-many-of kindness, and-sorried on the-evil.
and-now YHWH, take please soul-of-me from-me ; for good death-of-me from-lifes-of-me.
YHWH and-has-said, is-it-the-make-improve has-kindled to/for-you-f.

Jonah and-has-exited from the-city, and-has-dwelt from-east to/for-the-city ; and-he-has-done to/for-him there booth and-he-has-dwelt under-her in-the-shadow, until who he-will-see, what he-will-be in-the-city.
YHWH god plant and-has-counted and-has-ascended on to/for-Jonah to/for-be shadow on head-of-him, to/for-make-rescue to/for-him from-evil-of-him ; Jonah and-has-rejoiced on the-plant joy great.
the-god and-has-counted worm, in-ascend the-dawn to/for-the-morrow ; and-she-has-made-smite the-plant and-he-has-withered.

and-has-been like-rise the-sun and-has-counted god spirit-of east scorching, and-has-made-smite the-sun on head-of Jonah and-has-self-enwraped ; and-has-asked soul-of-him to/for-die, and-has-said, good die-of-me from-lifes-of-me.
god and-has-said toward Jonah, is-it-the-make-improve has-kindled to/for-you on the-plant ; and-has-said, make-improve death has-kindled to/for-me until.
YHWH and-has-said, you have-pitied on the-plant, who not have-toiled in-him and-not have-magnified-him ; that-son-of night has-been and-son-of night has-perished.
and-I not will-pity, on Nineveh the-city the-great ; who there in-her make-multiply from-two ten ten man who not has-known between right-of-him to/for-left-of-him, and-in-animal many.
